spec_reference: ADR-0008 (art medium: full Amano illustration, owner override of the spec pixel clause)
notes: active_profile selects how render_engine composites and validates. The owner chose full Amano illustration (ADR-0008), so 'illustration' is active.
The 'pixel' profile is retained verbatim (the original spec behaviour) so a hybrid pixel side-line is a one-word switch.
Real illustration art is authored at master_px; other output sizes are LANCZOS-resampled from it. Bump master_px to 4000 and author there if maximum fidelity at 4000 is required (heavier).

body and ship_class are anchored to OPPOSITE sides of the frame. Both are fully rendered illustrations; composited centred at similar scale they overlap almost completely and the result is an unreadable tangle, with ship_class — a 16-value rarity axis — hidden behind the figure. Separating them horizontally lets both read. Anything that maps ship-plate or body-plate coordinates into canvas space (engine/artgen/ship_condition.py, scene_element.py, render_engine._place_face) must honour anchor_x.
ship_condition deliberately has NO layer transform: its water must reach the frame edges. It reads ship_class's transform and maps ship coordinates into canvas space itself.
